verdict.rationale: Rippling documents developer APIs, a sandbox, and integrations with accounting systems (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite) that could support pulling payroll data for ledger reconciliation, but no evidence specifically describes a payroll journal export/API or an agent-driven reconciliation workflow. missing for 10: explicit payroll journal entry API/export documentation, evidence of automated reconciliation into a ledger, and any AI-agent-specific use case for this workflow.
